release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.3.9 Dedicated Beam Anchors, Wide Band Beam Detailing & Window Performance Release:
• Dedicated Beam Tendons: Tendons running longitudinally inside beams (e.g. Tendon X-8) preserve beam soffit formwork datum with zero slab deduction (560mm) and accurate top-of-beam anchor callouts (CL 140*).
• Wide Band Beams vs Narrow Stem Beams: Crossing chairs inside wide band beams (> 500mm, e.g. 2000x1000) sit directly on beam formwork at full elevation (925mm) without deduction, while narrow stem beams (<= 500mm) retain slab level formwork deduction.
• Taskbar Restore Deadlock Fix: Resolved Windows modal grab lockup when minimizing dialogs (Activation, Check for Updates, Quick Export) by synchronizing grab states with window map/unmap events.
• Instantaneous UI Restore: Viewport dimensions are cached to skip redundant full-canvas redraws on window restore and focus changes, eliminating 1-2s freezes.
